The gift was made on the occasion of Krishṇa-jayanti. The record contains two more grants made on the occasion of Krishṇa-jayanti, one in the year Kāļayukti (Śaka 1482) by Rāmalinga-nāyuḍu and another in the year Rākshasa (Śaka 1477) by the kāpus (farmers) and the karanas (accountants) of Niṭtūru, Gollapalle and Vēmulapalle, the former granting some lands and the latter grain at the rate of 1 mānika for every tūmu of the produce in the village.
